title: Fixed issues log
description: Engine and tooling defects found and fixed while building an example, kept for regression lookup. See docs/guidelines/NEW_EXAMPLE.md and docs/EXAMPLES.md.

id.description: Sequential, namespaced to 'found via examples' so it never collides with an unrelated id sequence (actions.json, achievements.json).

discovered_in.description: The example (or other build) that surfaced it, e.g. 'examples/primitives'.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the date it was fixed.

platforms.description: Which platforms showed the symptom. 'all' when it was platform-independent.

symptom.description: What was actually observed going wrong.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths touched by the fix.

regression_check.description: Which example/scene and platform to run, and what to look for, to confirm this hasn't come back.
